# Recovery capsule part 1/1 — D100 full projective-orbit formulation, exact 233 image and weak-boundary controls

This is a complete six-file ADDITION to the exact seed source **[internal-source-reference]**. BOTH materials are required. No worker result or original sandbox is a computational dependency. The accepted own110 record remains C622. This capsule preserves a C180 own233/weak000 NONWINNER, two deliberate weak-boundary controls, identity control, a complete exact eight-essential-variable projective formulation, its exporter, and exact semantic tests. It does NOT preserve the separate numerical optimization/MILP producers; that obligation remains separate. It does NOT prove projective-orbit infeasibility and contains no solved SAT/UNSAT claim.

## Mathematical scope

Let X_i be the 32 own-centered seed vertices, Q_f the 60 physical own-centered face poles, and oriented triples the seed's 60 true triangular facets. For p with d_i=1+p·X_i>0, set W_i=X_i/d_i. With tau_f=det(W_a,W_b,W_c)>0, the actual uniformly FILLED projective body's volume is sum(tau)/6 and centroid g=sum_f[tau_f(W_a+W_b+W_c)]/[4sum(tau)]. Let K_f=Q_f+p,h_f=1-K_f·g>0,Z_i=W_i-g,P_f=K_f/h_f. A subsequent nonsingular affine map sends row vectors to Z_i L and poles to P_f L^-T, with the SAME physical centroid, not the filled centroid of the polar. G=L L^T is SPD. Up to similarities, this covers all bounded projective images of the seed: an arbitrary positive-denominator projectivity becomes, after subtracting a translation, A'x/(1+p·x); scale-normalized SPD contributes five variables and p three. True incidence remains32/90/60,C180 throughout this orbit. This is not the class of all32-vertex polyhedra.

For each true directed edge ij define E_ij=Z_i^T G(W_j-W_i). For each dual adjacent pair f,t define T_ft=h_f K_f^T adj(G)K_t-h_t K_f^T adj(G)K_f. The exact positive-denominator identity T_ft=h_f^2 h_t P_f^T adj(G)(P_t-P_f) is checked for every local polar predicate. A vertex is strict U iff all adjacent E<0; a non-U must have some E>0 to exclude weak U. Faces use the analogous T tests for strict/weak S. For each true edge ij with faces f,t, E_ij>0 OR E_ji>0 OR T_ft>0 OR T_tf>0 excludes the CLOSED edge-equilibrium condition, including weak H. Local adjacency suffices because these are supporting linear-function maxima on a convex polytope/polar.

The QF_NRA formula normalizes G00+G11=1, enforces Sylvester SPD, all positive projective denominators, exact filled centroid equalities, positive centered supports, exactly one strict U and S with weak extrema excluded, and all90 closed-edge exclusions. It has eight essential variables plus32 inverse-denominator and3 centroid auxiliaries:43 declared reals and347 assertions. It is exported, NOT SOLVED. An independent exact S-expression parser evaluates every emitted definition and assertion on all four audited controls, including expected strictness failures. This is an executable semantics test, not an exclusion theorem.

## Exact constructions and controls

All four are actual uniformly filled convex32/90/60 bodies, independently audited by the seed's complete A/B implementations plus third centered integer mass integration. Feature mappings are recomputed, not assumed from input/rawlex labels. A/B agree in all common scientific fields, not whole bytes because auxiliary fields differ.

1. D100_CONTROL_IDENTITY: strict121,weak000. It is generated from already centered seed vertices, so its raw representation and A/B file hashes differ from the raw p_i/100 seed despite being the same translated physical shape.
2. D100_CONTROL_VERTEX_WEAK: strict(8,4,10),weak(0,1,1). Seed vertex0 and edge0--1 are weak. Minimal centered denominator180bits,max integer183.
3. D100_CONTROL_FACE_WEAK: strict(5,2,5),weak(1,0,1). Seed face31 and edge0--1 are weak. The actual incident seed faces of edge0--1 are31,33, NOT0,1. Minimal centered denominator193bits,max integer198.
4. COORD_D100_PROJECTIVE_METRIC_LOWLOSS_D1000000: strict233,weak000,all primitive zero counters0. Seed Sfaces[0,47],Uvertices[22,26,27],Hedges[[11,15],[22,26],[27,30]]. Independent audit rawlex S[1,58],U[4,7,31],H[[4,7],[15,26],[29,31]]. Raw rational maxdenominator57bits,maxnumerator62; the EXACT MINIMAL centered common denominator has3096bits,max centered integer3104. Third mass code's nonminimal common denominator has3097bits/max3105: these distinct costs must not be confused. All60 centered tetrahedra have positive volume and exact total first moments zero. This image is much more expensive arithmetically than the36-bit seed and is not a near-winner merely because a numerical loss was small.

The low-loss checkpoint stores exact p/L rational data with denominator10^6 and original IEEE754 HEX p/L values. Rounding is nearest ties-to-even applied to the exact Fraction represented by each float, not an unspecified decimal conversion. The capsule reconstructs from its literal rational p/L; numerical solvers are not required. The boundary controls are deterministic rational maps: for edge vector e at v, use a supporting normal n perpendicular e with n·v>0, columns n/(n·v), [e-v(v·e)/(v·v)]/[e·(e-v(v·e)/(v·v))], and v×e with positive determinant. Then vL=(1,0,0),eL=(0,1,0), producing exact weak U. Applying the same construction in the physical polar and using inverse transpose gives weak S.

The emitted formula has respectively2,14,9,5 false assertions on identity,weak-U,weak-S,low233, exactly matching full audits. No unaccounted mass,convexity,SPD,support or weak-condition failure occurs. Expected output receipts below and inside EXPECTED.json were checked against a separate source-only cold reconstruction.

## Exact inputs, reconstruction and verification

CPython3.13.5 standard library only; Python3.11+ compatible. Assertions enabled; no randomness, floating optimization or precision parameters enter reconstruction. Save SOURCE6.b64 from [internal-source-reference], the full base64 block below as ADDITION6.b64, and this decoder as RESTORE.py. Run `python -B -S RESTORE.py SOURCE6.b64 ADDITION6.b64 absent-root`. The root must initially be absent. This cold reconstruction was executed, all35 output byte/hash receipts matched.

```python
from pathlib import Path
import base64,hashlib,json,lzma,subprocess,sys
assert __debug__
root=Path(sys.argv[3]);root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
specs=[(sys.argv[1],'seed',9368,'adb438e45e92f946524ccac9b804d2e7d2c9b7455faffe6ab820a174249ef466',19753,'9793ea2121a3149cada862af94f18fa13e9192a7014dcba1ccb92366162a5949'),(sys.argv[2],'addition',11356,'1e5499a98e9fdf81b18005a3b43735620efb2acea68841faf0d46d45d81099ad',24108,'2e14581e4e4b78161c7fdc371418df9ae863dcdae63303baa6a2c08a3465b835')]
for file,sub,ns,hs,nb,hb in specs:
 s=''.join(Path(file).read_text().split()).encode();assert len(s)==ns and hashlib.sha256(s).hexdigest()==hs
 b=lzma.decompress(base64.b64decode(s,validate=True));assert len(b)==nb and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==hb
 d=json.loads(b);assert len(d)==6
 for name,text in d.items():
  p=Path(name);assert not p.is_absolute() and '..' not in p.parts
  q=root/sub/p;q.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);q.write_bytes(text.encode())
def run(*args):subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','-S',*map(str,args)],check=True)
run(root/'seed/REPLAY.py',root/'seed-proof')
run(root/'addition/REPLAY.py',root/'seed',root/'seed-proof',root/'new-proof')
```
